title: Tighten the card visual checks and keep the Linux baselines current
description: Follow-up from TASK-3.20 review (MINOR, NITs) and spec scope concerns: containment gap, duplicate decode, unasserted artifact steps, baseline regeneration on Playwright bumps, and an undigested container image.

nodes.title: Tighten the card visual checks and keep the Linux baselines current
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Read big-index cards drawn in code

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a card part with no <path>, When partsOutsideCard runs, Then it reports that part

Given a Dependabot Playwright bump that changes rendering, When Visual goes red, Then the README documents (or a workflow automates) regenerating baselines with gh workflow run visual.yml --ref <branch> -f update=true

implementationPlan:
1. partsOutsideCard reports a part with no <path> (paths.length === 0 guard) + test removing Qs rank paths and the 3h suit group.
2. Logo test: drop the inline decode; logoProblems already checks it.
3. README: regenerate baselines after a rendering-changing Playwright bump; unit test pins the paragraph.

Full spec: doit/TASK-3.23/spec.md
